newsitem.title: TURKEY: BASKETBALL-ULKERSPOR SEE OFF LIMOGES IN NAIL-BITER.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-ULKERSPOR SEE OFF LIMOGES IN NAIL-BITER.

text.p: Turkey's Ulkerspor edged ahead in the final minutes of the second period of overtime to beat Limoges of France 99-91 in an exciting EuroLeague basketball group A match on Thursday.
Neither team managed to take the initiative in the first half, the score standing at only 4-4 after five minutes, but Ulkerspor carried a slight 36-34 lead into the second half.
By the 35th minute Limoges were beginning to dominate and were leading 65-56, but the Turks battled on, levelling the scores at 73-73 at the end of normal time.
The first session of overtime failed to separate the two teams, but in the end, baskets from Harun Erdenay, the game's top scorer with 28 points, tipped the result in Ulkerspor's favour.
Defeat for Limoges leaves them struggling in group A and facing a tough schedule in the second phase starting in January
